title: Reliability Engineering Bathtub Curve for Fine-Tuning Steps

original_idea.body:
# Bathtub Curve for Fine-Tuning Steps

**Problem:** Whether the safety-failure-rate vs training-step curve shows infant-mortality and wear-out phases is untested.

**Direction:** Measure safety-failure rate at each checkpoint, test for bathtub shape, identify the optimal early-stopping window.

**Why it matters:** A principled early-stopping criterion.

**Relevant context:** NeurIPS 2024 scaling laws; arXiv:2507.03662.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Early-stopping criterion is useful but the bathtub framing adds a gap; safety chain is moderate.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Checkpoint-wise safety evaluation across one training chain; guided.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused failure-rate curve; one fine-tune chain with checkpointing.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Open models, cheap; weak lab incentive on this framing.

low_compute.reasoning: One chain of checkpoints plus inference; one GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Overoptimization-over-training is known; the bathtub framing may be partly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Overoptimization dynamics known; bathtub framing may be open.
